title.narrative: Promoting Gender Transformative and Youth Inclusive Democracy in Malawi

description.narrative: The action relates to enhancing meaningful participation of women, youth and marginalised groups in political processes and decision-making. Political Processes include, standing and campaigning for community, local and national leadership roles, taking up roles in political parties and involvement in public policy making. Decision-making structures cut across grassroots, local and national level structures.
